tickerText: [TENNIS] WTA Hamburg Ladies Open heads into the round of 16 at Am Rothenbaum as Udvardy and Kraus advance on clay • [SQUASH] World Junior Championships Day 3 begins in Niagara-on-the-Lake with top seeds Zakaria and Singh into the last 16 • [BADMINTON] World No. 1 An Se-young withdraws from China Open as first-round action continues in Changzhou through July 22 • [PICKLEBALL] PPA Asia 500 Singapore Open opens tomorrow at Sports Arina with 659 players and a $79,000 purse • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Star Contender São José qualifying wraps with women's singles and doubles joining the fray ahead of Thursday's main draw

newsItems.title: WTA Hamburg Ladies Open Reaches Round of 16
newsItems.excerpt: The MSC Hamburg Ladies Open continues at Am Rothenbaum with third seed Panna Udvardy and eighth seed Sinja Kraus among those advancing through Tuesday's round of 32.

newsItems.title: Junior Squash Seeds Reach Last 16
newsItems.excerpt: Mohamad Zakaria and Anahat Singh cruise into the round of 16 at Niagara-on-the-Lake, while Brazil's Laura Silva rallies from two sets down to stay alive.

newsItems.title: An Se-young Withdraws from China Open
newsItems.excerpt: World No. 1 An Se-young pulls out of the Super 1000 in Changzhou with a foot injury, elevating Chen Yufei to top seed as first-round play continues.

newsItems.title: WTT São José Qualifying Enters Final Day
newsItems.excerpt: Qualifying at the Star Contender in Brazil concludes today with women's singles and doubles joining the fray; Hugo Calderano and Bruna Takahashi enter the main draw Thursday.
